name: Half-hourly Evapotranspiration Estimation Dataset (China 2000–2024)
description: A long-range half-hourly benchmark dataset for evaluating models that estimate evapotranspiration across China from 2000 to 2024.
domain: climate science / hydrology / tabular time series
reputation: Specialized research dataset with adoption primarily within hydrology and climate-science groups rather than broad ML benchmarks.
notes: Long temporal span and spatial heterogeneity can introduce nonstationarity and missing-data issues; not an LLM benchmark; potential leakage if temporal splits are not carefully constructed; common evaluation uses multiple regression metrics (RMSE, MAE, R²).
